resources.title: Data Lake Zone & Partitioning Reference
resources.description: A compiled reference sheet for the raw/staged/curated zone pattern and Hive-style partitioning taught across Chapters 1, 3, and 4 — a partition-granularity decision table, the MSCK REPAIR TABLE vs. partition projection tradeoff, and a minimal CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE template you can adapt to any new table.

resources.title: Redshift Table Design Checklist
resources.description: A step-by-step checklist for choosing distribution style, DISTKEY, and SORTKEY before a table has real production data depending on it, plus the actual orders/customers DDL this course's own loading and distribution lessons build toward.

resources.title: Sample Orders Dataset
resources.description: A small, realistic CSV of order records (order_id, customer_id, order_date, region, product_category, order_total) matching the orders table used throughout this course's S3, Glue, Athena, and Redshift lessons — small enough to load into a sandbox bucket and run every COPY, CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE, and partitioning example against directly.

resources.title: Orders Pipeline State Machine Definition
resources.description: The complete, deployable ASL JSON for the three-stage crawl-transform-notify state machine built across Lessons 35-38 — crawler, then ETL job, then a success/failure Lambda notification, with Retry and a shared Catch target already wired in. Paste it straight into the Step Functions console to run it as-is.
